newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 5.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian magistrates association UNAMACI urges public to denounce corrupt members of their profession
- Staff at security company CODIVAL, which transports money and valuables between banks and clients, to start strike Wednesday over working conditions and other grievances

- Ivory Coast embarking on campaign of road and bridge building in 1997 to promote national integration and ensure that all areas of the country are close to a metalled road, newspaper investigation shows
- University in Ivory Coast's second town of Bouake paralysed; soldiers bar students from lecture halls after protests over beating of student militant.
- Fire ravages cocoa plantations and forest either side of roads between Adzope, Abengourou and Bondoukou in eastern Ivory Coast
- Trade mission from Quebec visits Ivory Coast
- Student leader Guillaume Soro calls for negotiations to end crisis in Ivory Coast's universitiers
- Ivorian rubber firm SAPH shares quoted on Abidjan Stock Exchange at opening price of 13,500 CFA francs
- Southwestern port of San Pedro looks to expand further to help promote development of hinterland and meet needs of neighbouring countries; projected investment needs total 80 billion CFA francs
